Source: NASA FIRMS near-real-time active fire data, UTC. Unit = unique 1-km fire cell per day and day/night period: NOAA-20, NOAA-21, Aqua and Terra detections are merged on a 0.01° grid so one fire seen by several satellites counts once. FRP is the strongest single overpass in the cell, and FRP and brightness are never averaged across instruments (VIIRS 375 m: Ti4; MODIS 1 km: T21), so they are shown side by side. Confidence: VIIRS l/n/h; MODIS below 30 low, 30–80 nominal, above 80 high; across instruments the highest class is used. Zones are approximate lat/lon bands.
